identification: Pair of Victorian open balloon-back dining/drawing room chairs, about 1860-1880: shaped top rail, waisted uprights, centre rail carved with a turned rosette between scrolls, stuffover seats re-covered in modern cream floral tapestry, turned and ringed tapering front legs, plain splayed back legs. Timber is red-brown; catalogue says mahogany, but in Tasmania Australian red cedar is also common for this form and should be checked. Cloud scan correct.
